title: Visited positions form an interval
statement: For every multi-tape Turing machine $M$, initial state $q$, Boolean input $V$, time $T\in\mathbb N$, and work tape $j$, the head positions visited from time $0$ through time $T$ form an integer interval $[a,b]$ for some integers $a\le 0\le b$, and both endpoints $a$ and $b$ are visited.
hypotheses_covered: time T is a natural number
